## Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New command / flag
- [ ] Breaking change (existing commands/flags/output change behavior)
- [ ] Refactor / internal

## Checklist
- [ ] `make build` builds cleanly (Linux)
- [ ] `go vet ./...` and `gofmt` are clean
- [ ] `golangci-lint run` is clean (config in `.golangci.yml`)
- [ ] `make test` passes
- [ ] New commands/flags trace to a real swagger field or cicd payload (no invented API)
- [ ] Help text notes any control-plane-only (not-yet-enforced) behavior
- [ ] No secrets, internal hostnames, or personal paths in code, docs, or commits
- [ ] PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
- [ ] Commits are signed off (DCO)
- [ ] Docs updated (`README.md` / `docs/`) where behavior changed

## Notes for Reviewers

Anything that needs special attention, migration steps, or follow-up work.
